# The achievements export names creature types in prose ("Sporalis", "Animated Hands"); the F30
# reference labels each listing with a race ("Fungusman", "Reanimated Hand"). Neither states a race
# id, so nothing joins them but this table, which is OURS: written by hand against the full
# reference vocabulary (111 labels, 2026-09-20) and the owner's own progress, which proves a term
# is satisfiable in this game whenever its count is above zero.
# A term that is NOT here has no known location, and the view says so rather than guessing — most
# are creatures this game has not opened zones for (Shissar, Vah Shir, Drakkin). Add a row only
# when the reference really lists the creature; do not invent one to make a row look complete.
# The labels are the reference's, MISTAKES INCLUDED: it files pandas under "Ulthork", werebats
# under "Kobold" and mummies under "Zombie". This table maps to what the file says, because that
# is what the atlas is grouped by; the view names the mobs so the player can see what they would
# Terms under a lead-in carry it: "Clockwork: Beetles, Boars, ..." is "Clockwork Beetles",
# "Clockwork Boars" - NOT ordinary beetles. Matching is exact, ignoring case.
